newsitem.title: USA: Neurocrine sees slightly lower 1997 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Neurocrine sees slightly lower 1997 EPS.

text.p: Neurocrine Biosciences Inc expects slightly lower per share earnings and break-even cash flow in 1997, Chief Financial Officer Paul Hawran said Monday
Speaking at the New York Society of Security Analysts's Health Care Industry Conference, Hawran said he expects to end 1997 with a cash position similar to that at the end of 1996.
He said the company has the financial strength for its current programs through the year 2001.
Later, asked by Reuters if he saw 1997 earnings per share similar to 1996's $0.35, Hawran said that might be optimistic. He said 1997 earnings per share could be "a penny or so less."
Asked to comment on revenue comparisons, he said analysts are projecting revenues of about $23 million.
Neurocrine had revenues of $19.2 million in 1996.
